name: COMBINED
tagline: Every high-conviction insider signal in one strategy
description: Enters a trade whenever insiders show strong conviction: a C-Suite (CEO/CFO) open-market buy over $100K, 2+ insiders buying within 14 days, or heavy open-market selling that historically marks good entry points. Captures the broadest set of signals, which is why it delivered the highest ROI of all strategies tested.

name: INDUSTRY_MOMENTUM
description: Trades only the highest-confidence insider signals (75%+ confidence) that appear while their industry is in an accumulation phase. Fewer, better-timed trades with the strongest win rate of the top three.

name: CONVICTION
description: The purest signal: only open-market purchases of $100,000+ made by a Chief Executive Officer or Chief Financial Officer with their own money. A smaller, cleaner book of trades built on the most trusted insider signal.
